(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-hydration-status]'); return 'hydrationAttr=' + (el ? el.getAttribute('data-hydration-status') : 'NO ELEMENT') + ' readyState=' + document.readyState + ' bodyLen=' + document.body.innerText.length; })()
(() => { const e = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(n => n.tagName === 'SCRIPT').map(n => n.src || n.textContent.slice(0, 60)); return JSON.stringify(e.slice(0, 6)); })()
